title: Pistol shrimp की चुटकी से मछली बेहोश क्यों? 🦐
cover_text: झींगे की चुटकी में *हज़ारों डिग्री* गर्मी!

cover.prompt: A pistol shrimp with a huge oversized snapping claw thrust toward the camera, orange-and-white banded body, on a sandy coral reef floor, a bright silvery bubble bursting just in front of the claw tip with a tiny flash of light, clear turquoise water, bright sun, calm empty deep-blue water across the top, extreme close-up

source: Versluis et al., Science 2000 'How Snapping Shrimp Snap'; Smithsonian; Encyclopaedia Britannica

fact_check.weak: Fairly well-known fact, and the heat hook suggests the heat stuns the fish when the shockwave does (the ~4700 K stays inside a tiny bubble for a split second)

hook_score.why: Contradiction (no touch, yet unconscious) opens a precise question that only the end can answer, and it builds well with the claw-speed line; visual and true.
hook_score.was: इस झींगे की एक चुटकी, हज़ारों डिग्री गर्मी पैदा करती है!
